say:1:1033444001:1.text: Yes, the Thorned Guards are making up for our past mistakes under the orders of Captain Parisa.
say:1:1033444001:1.source_cn: 是的，在帕瑞莎队长的命令下，荆棘要弥补过去的错误。
say:1:1033444001:1.male: Yes, the Thorned Guards are making up for our past mistakes under the orders of Captain Parisa.
say:1:1033444001:1.female: Yes, the Thorned Guards are making up for our past mistakes under the orders of Captain Parisa.

say:2:1033444002:1.text: I'm worried that the rift between the Thorned Guards and the refugees will only grow deeper if we deliver insufficient supplies.
say:2:1033444002:1.source_cn: 我担心难民会因为运送的物资太少，和荆棘的隔阂继续加深。
say:2:1033444002:1.male: I'm worried that the rift between the Thorned Guards and the refugees will only grow deeper if we deliver insufficient supplies.
say:2:1033444002:1.female: I'm worried that the rift between the Thorned Guards and the refugees will only grow deeper if we deliver insufficient supplies.

say:3:1033444003:1.text: After all, it was us who drove them away during the exclusion edict.
say:3:1033444003:1.source_cn: 毕竟封锁令下达时，驱赶他们的正是我们……
say:3:1033444003:1.male: After all, it was us who drove them away during the exclusion edict.
say:3:1033444003:1.female: After all, it was us who drove them away during the exclusion edict.
